name: Privacy and release disclosures
userOutcome: A user and App Review receive accurate descriptions of permissions, local processing, collected data, required-reason APIs, purchases, and deletion.
productionDataSource: Shipping app behavior, Release bundle Info.plist, PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy, in-app policy, and the hosted policy submitted to App Store Connect.
errorBehavior: The in-app policy remains available without a network connection. Permission denial does not claim data was saved. External policy/support links must be public and reachable without authentication.
accessibilityRequirements: Policy headings and links have meaningful labels
Privacy copy remains scrollable at accessibility text sizes
prohibitedBehavior: Do not claim a learned classifier is bundled when it is absent
Do not omit required-reason API declarations used by shipping code
Do not request broad Photo Library read access for system-picker import
Do not submit a private or login-gated privacy-policy URL
acceptanceTests: Release bundle contains PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy at the app root
Release Info.plist matches camera and add-only Photos behavior
Human comparison of App Store privacy answers, in-app policy, hosted policy, and shipping code
